design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (residential_electricity_care, category power).

[Step 0 - draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"task": 0, "key": "env_0029_retail_energy_supplier/residential_electricity_care/0", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [5, 6, 6, 5]}. --tasks 2 shows task 1 draws 3 prerequisite problems with [4, 6, 5, 6]. Assignment: renewal loyalty credit (root) 6, renewal rate 6, referral credit 5, dual-fuel restoration 5.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: power_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit (root, power_credit renewal_loyalty_credit, post_renewal_loyalty_credit_25af361b), power_ext_renewal_rate (power_renew, accept_renewal_offer_e5d86473, owner=user), power_ext_referral_credit_amount (power_credit referral_credit, post_referral_credit_79c21554), power_ext_dual_fuel_restoration (power_credit dual_fuel_credit, post_dual_fuel_credit_18175409). Left for task 1 (headroom check against its draw of 3 prerequisites, [4,6,5,6]): power_adjustment (rebill credit), the power_billing_disputes intake (billing dispute above the agent limit), the sign-up/online credit, power_plan_change, power_cancel/withdraw and power_etf_charge - a Free Nights time-of-use billing-error tree fits there without touching anything claimed here.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: Diane Abernathy wants 'the loyalty credit the renewal email mentioned' on her electricity account. Core scored value: the renewal loyalty credit (116.00). Hidden chain: the loyalty-credit rule says the credit 'is not posted until the agreement's current term starts on the day after the contract end date stated on its latest renewal notice, on the plan that notice offers' (no such term: plan_change_date empty) and 'is fixed only after the agreement's bill lines carry the referral credit owed for every referred customer ...' (Owen Castillo, referred by her, completed two cycles; no referral line). The acceptance itself carries the renewal rate, whose rule says it 'is fixed only after the agreement's bill lines carry the dual-fuel credit owed for every billing cycle within the billing dispute lookback on whose start date a Beacon Ridge gas agreement on the same premise was active' (cycle 2026-07-01 has none). Depth: restoration -> renewal rate -> loyalty credit (2 hops) plus referral -> loyalty credit. Breadth: gas agreement and gas ledger (another difficulty), twelve-month usage, dual-fuel line count, net twelve-month amount, notices (channel), term dates, referral lookup.

[Problem-tree card]
root power_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit (agent).
edge 1: power_ext_renewal_rate -> power_ext_dual_fuel_restoration, kind value_input, gate credited_bundle_cycles, form state, sentence 'The renewal rate is fixed only after the agreement's bill lines carry the dual-fuel credit owed for every billing cycle within the billing dispute lookback on whose start date a Beacon Ridge gas agreement on the same premise was active.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; waits on a record-visible state (dual-fuel lines per cycle); no tool/id/code token; scope = cycles in lookback with gas active (exactly the restoration rule's scope). Exactly one write of the difficulty books dual-fuel credit lines (post_dual_fuel_credit_18175409). False at opening: gas 59376ab3... active from 2025-02-01; energy line be1cbea6... for 2026-07-01 has no dual-fuel twin (2a84bfe9... 2026-06 and f21b0a2a... 2026-08 do). Flip: step 12 adds the 2026-07-01 line; twelve-month count 10 -> 11.
edge 2: power_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit -> power_ext_renewal_rate, value_input, gate renewed_term_months, form state (round 2), sentence 'The renewal loyalty credit is not posted until the agreement's current term starts on the day after the contract end date stated on its latest renewal notice, on the plan that notice offers.' (negated direction). Only the customer's acceptance of the renewal offer (accept_renewal_offer_e5d86473) writes a term starting the day after the notice's stated end date on the offered plan; a plan change to another plan is not a renewal. False at opening: ef419fc4....plan_change_date = '', notice 22a63554... effective_date 2026-10-31.
edge 3: power_ext_renewal_loyalty_credit -> power_ext_referral_credit_amount, value_input, gate loyalty_referral_lines, form state, sentence 'The renewal loyalty credit is fixed only after the agreement's bill lines carry the referral credit owed for every referred customer whose agreement has reached the qualifying number of completed cycles.' Only post_referral_credit_79c21554 books referral lines. False at opening: b1a11f95... (Owen) referred_by = Diane, cycles ending 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-31, Diane has no referral_credit line.
Topological order used: restoration (12), referral (14), acceptance (16), loyalty (18). Free pairs restoration/referral and referral/acceptance commute (round 2: the referral's renewal season is read from the renewal notice, which no write changes; replay of order 12/16/14/18 gives the same values and terminal state). Deletion sensitivity (actual runs of /tmp authoring calc with steps skipped): skip restoration -> renewal rate 10.63 (not 10.42); skip referral -> loyalty 106.00 (not 116.00); skip acceptance -> loyalty compute raises on the empty term start (no renewed term) and the terminal agreement keeps the old term. No-hint proof: user_scenario names only the loyalty credit; Owen, the summer credit and the acceptance appear only as reactions to what the representative raises. Tools validate nothing (single create/update each). User-owned problem: the acceptance of the renewal offer is the customer's own act per the blueprint ('the customer alone confirms ... an acceptance of a renewal offer'), completed on the spot.

[Base-invariant card] power_renew: power_renewal.renewal_active ('A renewal is accepted only on an active agreement.') - ef419fc4....status = active; power_renewal.post_expiry_grace (time; anchor power_agreements.plan_change_date, not_after, 30 calendar days, inclusive) - not rolled over, plan_change_date empty, election 2026-09-24 is before contract end 2026-10-31, so the on-time renewal path applies (new term starts 2026-11-01, base sentence 'When the election is made on or before contract_end_date, the new term starts the day after contract_end_date'). power_credit writes: power_signup_credit.one_signup_credit (dedup on sign-up/online only; none of these lines is of those kinds), credit_while_supplied (status active), power_referral_credit.one_credit_per_referred_customer (Owen has no referral line yet; the dual-fuel and loyalty lines name no referred customer), power_agg_dual_fuel.one_dual_fuel_per_cycle (no dual-fuel line for 2026-07-01; the loyalty and referral lines are other kinds), power_renewal as scope. Base-layer note (routed around, not edited): every power_credit write inherits the referral dedup gate whose action binding is referred_customer_id, so the loyalty and dual-fuel tools carry a referred_customer_id argument whose contract value for a non-referral line is the empty string.

[Business-object card] Target object: Diane's agreement ef419fc4-5fe7-4983-83af-af7ef0abd8fd at 2207 Brookside Lane (PECO). Restoration correlates by (agreement, billing_period_start 2026-07-01). Referral correlates by referred_customer_id 7e95608f... (Owen, agreement b1a11f95..., premise ce5ac56b... at 2213 Brookside Lane, a separate household). Loyalty credit correlates by the renewed term's first cycle 2026-11-01. Rows included in aggregates: 22 energy lines (usage, count), 18 dual-fuel lines (count), notices (email channel), gas energy lines (count 19, therms 810 in window). Excluded: gas sign-up credit (not an energy line), sign-up/online credits (posted 2025-03-03, outside the twelve-month posted window, not counted by type filters).

[Factor card] (tier taken / evidence / baseline figure from the Step 5 sensitivity run)
dual-fuel restoration (expected 12.50, all-baseline 5.00): bundle_uplift (cross gas, multi) fixed AND 24-month gas plan -> 2.00, baseline 9.50; restoration_compensation (method) 10 lines -> x1.5, baseline 9.00; tenure_addition 22 months -> 0.50, baseline 12.00; usage_addition avg 1,006.9 kWh -> 1.00, baseline 11.50; paperless_addition web AND email -> 0.50, baseline 12.00. Near-miss: the dual-fuel line of the cycle starting 2025-09-01 is exactly twelve whole months old and is outside the count.
referral credit (92.50, all-baseline 50.00): renewal_season_scaling (method) 37 days to end -> x1.25, baseline 80.00; referrer_bundle_bonus (cross gas, multi) -> 10, baseline 82.50; referral_count_bonus first -> 10, baseline 82.50; seasoned_referrer_bonus 22 lines -> 5, baseline 87.50; referral_paperless_bonus -> 5, baseline 87.50.
renewal rate (10.42, all-baseline 11.89): tenure 0.25 (10.77); bundle 0.30 after restoration (10.84); commitment 24-month expiring term 0.20 (10.70); paperless 0.10 (10.56); early election 37 days 0.20 (10.70); volume_scaling (method) x1.4 (10.84). Near-miss: before the restoration the count is 10 and the bundle reduction would be the partial tier.
renewal loyalty credit (116.00, all-baseline 50.00): renewed_term_scaling (method) 24 months x1.2 (105.00); loyalty_tenure_scaling (method) x1.10 (110.00); bundle_loyalty_bonus (cross gas, multi) active AND 19 gas lines -> 20 (96.00); spend_bonus net 1,150.51 -> 10 (106.00); referral_loyalty_bonus one line -> 10 (106.00); whole_home_bonus (cross gas) 810 therms -> 10 (106.00). Near-miss: before the referral and restoration postings the net is 1,255.51, which would land on the high spend tier.
Every overwrite is declared: power_agg_dual_fuel per-cycle sentence, power_renewal offered-rate sentence, power_referral_credit amount sentence, power_renewal loyalty-amount sentence; all base gates are inherited.

[Seed] 72 rows: 2 customers, 2 premises, 2 power agreements, 44 power bill lines, 1 notice, 1 gas agreement, 20 gas bill lines; every row is read by a gold finder or named in a gold argument (replay closure 72/72). Automatic clauses checked: final options notice not due before 2026-10-01; Owen's sign-up credit needs 3 completed cycles (he has 2); no rollover; no pass-through. No cache field is used.

[Persona] Pressed-for-time hygienist; opens with the loyalty credit only; credentials only on request (phone, then SSN last four, then ZIP); gas, Owen and the summer credit only as reactions; accepts the renewal only after the representative explains it is needed, taking plan/rate/dates as stated, and runs the hand-over herself; closes when told the loyalty credit is posted. No computed answer appears in the persona.

[Verification] Commands run (repo root): check_task_tools (TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK), check_extended --task 0 (EXTENDED OK), check_compute --task 0 (COMPUTE OK: 4 comps, 22 factors, 4 cross factors, all baselines differ), replay_tasks --task 0 (REPLAY OK, closure 72/72), check_solvability --task 0 (SOLVABILITY OK), check_grounding --task 0 (GROUNDING OK), check_cross_fire --task 0 (SCOPE OK). check_traceability is deferred until the KB is published. The authoring evaluator replayed the gold writes with the real tools and reproduced 12.50, 92.50, 10.42, 116.00 at each step's handling time.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the finders and the four policy rules alone: the loyalty rule names two things it waits on -> look for referral credits owed (referral finder by referred_by_customer_id shows Owen, 2 completed cycles) and for the acceptance (renewal rule); the renewal rule waits on dual-fuel credits for gas-active cycles (gas finder: active from 2025-02-01; ledger: 2026-07-01 missing). Order restoration/referral -> acceptance -> loyalty; each figure re-derives to the same value. No second solution: dates are forced by the base term rules, the cycle in progress and the missing cycle.

[Revision round 2 - policy-task audit] 
F-T0-1 (two orders of referral vs acceptance gave two referral credits). Symptom: the acceptance rewrote contract_end_date, which the referral's renewal-season scaling read. Root cause: an input shared by two unordered sibling prerequisites. Change: the referral rule now reads the renewal season from the latest renewal notice ('the renewal season is read from the latest renewal notice on the referring agreement, whose stated contract end date stays as printed whatever renewal or plan change the agreement records'); compute binding season_notice_end_date = LATEST(power_notices.effective_date, power_renewal_notice). Re-run: gold order 12/14/16/18 and swapped order 12/16/14/18 both give 12.50, 92.50, 10.42, 116.00 and the same terminal state; order_uniqueness rewritten with the actual run. Scored values unchanged.
O-7 (action-form fallback not justified): the loyalty <- acceptance edge is now state form: 'The renewal loyalty credit is not posted until the agreement's current term starts on the day after the contract end date stated on its latest renewal notice, on the plan that notice offers.' Only the acceptance writes that state (accepting another plan is a plan change); fallback_reason removed; condition and the closure edge updated.
O-8 (renewal-rate sentence demanded dual-fuel lines on 0.00 plans): sentence now waits on 'the dual-fuel credit owed for every billing cycle ...'; condition adds 'on which the plan in force carried a per-cycle dual-fuel credit above 0.00'.
O-4: owner=user docstrings now say 'On success the agreement record shows'. O-6: effect texts made general (charter side). O-11 (paperless partial tier reduces to 'web, no email notice yet' under base delivery rules) and O-10 accepted as noted by the audit; annual usage fields on the premise remain informational, no ladder reads them.
Gates re-run after the change: see the final gate block of the difficulty.
user_scenario: You are Diane Abernathy, a dental hygienist who lives at 2207 Brookside Lane in Lansdale, Pennsylvania, and you are calling Beacon Ridge Energy on a Thursday morning between patients, so you are friendly but a little pressed for time. At the start of September an email from Beacon Ridge told you that the price lock on your home electricity runs out on October 31, and it mentioned that customers who stay on get a loyalty bill credit. You have already made up your mind to keep your electricity with Beacon Ridge, and the reason for your call is simple: you want that loyalty credit put on your electricity account. You do not know how big it is, you never saw it on any bill, and you are not calling about anything else. You do not know your customer number. When the representative asks how to find you, you give your phone number, 2155550104, and if they need more to confirm it is you, you give the last four digits of your Social Security number, 1427; only if they still need something else do you add your ZIP code, 19446. Your email on file is diane.abernathy@verizon.net if they ask for it. If you are asked about other Beacon Ridge services, you say yes, your gas at the same house is with Beacon Ridge too and has been since early last year. You signed up for the electricity online back in October 2024. If the representative brings up your neighbour Owen Castillo, you remember that in June you gave Owen at 2213 Brookside Lane your customer number when he switched, and you are glad if something is owed to you for it; you never heard anything more about it. If they mention a credit that should have been on one of your summer bills, you say you never noticed and you are happy for them to fix it. You are fine with the representative posting any credits that belong on your account without asking you each time. If the representative explains that the loyalty credit only comes once you have accepted the renewal offer yourself, you say that is fine, you were planning to stay anyway, and you ask what rate and term you would be accepting; you take the plan, rate and dates exactly as the representative states them, and when they hand the acceptance over to you, you complete it yourself right then and read back what it confirms. You do not suggest any rate or plan of your own and you do not ask for a different plan. Once the representative tells you the loyalty credit has been posted to your account and how much it is, you thank them, say that is all you needed, and end the call. If they quote a figure, you do not argue with it; you have nothing to compare it against.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed by her customer number; without the profile nothing can be looked up.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account detail may be discussed and no credit or acceptance recorded before identity verification passes (two matching credentials).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her premise at 2207 Brookside Lane: PA, PECO for electricity and gas, residential class.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The premise id ties the electricity agreement to the gas agreement on the same premise, which several bundle tiers read; the residential class keeps the renewal within the plan's eligibility.

evaluation_criteria.necessity: The ledger is the evidence of the missing dual-fuel credit (the renewal rate waits on it), of the missing referral credit (the loyalty credit waits on it), and of the usage average, dual-fuel line count, energy line count and twelve-month net amount that the factor tiers rest on.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.power_agreement_id: power_agreement_id: value ef419fc4-5fe7-4983-83af-af7ef0abd8fd; basis: the find_power_agreements(customer_id) return lists exactly one electricity agreement for Diane (Price Lock 24 at 2207 Brookside Lane), and the tool docstring says the Id is 'the residential electricity agreement number ... as read from the agreement lookup'; uniqueness: she holds no other electricity agreement, so every correct agent passes this id.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.referred_customer_id: value "" (empty); basis: the docstring of this tool reads 'this credit is not a referral credit and names no referred customer, so the identifier passed is the empty string ""'; uniqueness: the line is not a referral credit, so no customer number may be named and the empty string is the only value the contract allows.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_period_start: value 2026-07-01; basis: the ledger read shows dual-fuel credit lines for every cycle from 2025-02-01 through 2026-08-01 except the cycle starting 2026-07-01, while the gas agreement on the same premise has been active since 2025-02-01; the restoration rule says the missed credit 'is restored as one dual-fuel credit line for that cycle'; uniqueness: it is the only cycle within the lookback with gas active on its start date and no dual-fuel line, so the cycle start is forced.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_amount_usd: value 12.50 (posted as -12.50). Standard: per-cycle dual-fuel credit of Price Lock 24 = 5.00. Bundle uplift: gas agreement on the premise is Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24, fixed-rate with a 24-month term -> long-term bundle uplift 2.00. Restoration compensation: dual-fuel credit lines with cycle start less than twelve whole months before 2026-09-24 = cycles 2025-10..2026-08 minus 2026-07 = 10 lines -> established-bundle factor 1.5 -> (5.00+2.00)x1.5 = 10.50. Tenure addition: service start 2024-11-01 is 22 whole months before -> mid-tenure 0.50. Usage addition: 11 energy lines started in the window total 11,076 kWh, average 1,006.9 -> high-usage 1.00. Paperless addition: web enrollment and the renewal notice delivered by email -> full 0.50. 10.50+0.50+1.00+0.50 = 12.50, rounded once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock post_referral_credit_79c21554 so it can be called.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.power_agreement_id: power_agreement_id: value ef419fc4-5fe7-4983-83af-af7ef0abd8fd; basis: the find_power_agreements(customer_id) return lists exactly one electricity agreement for Diane (Price Lock 24 at 2207 Brookside Lane), and the tool docstring says the Id is 'the residential electricity agreement number ... as read from the agreement lookup'; uniqueness: she holds no other electricity agreement, so every correct agent passes this id. The referral rule posts the credit 'on the referring customer's earliest-enrolled power agreement that is active on the posting date', which is this single active agreement.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.referred_customer_id: value 7e95608f-7677-4524-b1a6-342404cae2f5; basis: find_power_agreements(referred_by_customer_id=62b11348-7d5b-4360-8f83-80dde1ade6e0) returns Owen Castillo's agreement whose customer_id is 7e95608f-7677-4524-b1a6-342404cae2f5; the referral rule posts the line 'with the referred customer named on the line'; uniqueness: he is the only customer naming Diane as referrer, so his customer number is the only value.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.billing_period_start: value 2026-09-01; basis: the referral rule says the credit is posted 'on the bill of the billing cycle in progress on the posting date'; her cycles run from the first to the last day of each month (the latest energy line is 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31) and the posting date is 2026-09-24; uniqueness: the cycle in progress started 2026-09-01.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.credit_amount_usd: value 92.50 (posted as -92.50). Standard: plan referral credit of Price Lock 24 = 50.00. Renewal-season scaling: the latest renewal notice (2026-09-01) states the contract end date 2026-10-31, 37 days after 2026-09-24 (1 to 60); the notice's date stays as printed whether or not the acceptance has already been recorded -> near-renewal season factor 1.25 -> 62.50. Referrer bundle bonus: gas agreement on the premise active and fixed-rate -> 10.00. Referral count bonus: no referral credit line on the agreement yet -> first-referral bonus 10.00. Seasoned referrer bonus: 22 energy charge lines (12 or more) -> 5.00. Referral paperless bonus: web enrollment and email notice -> 5.00. 62.50+10+10+5+5 = 92.50, rounded once.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.power_agreement_id: power_agreement_id: value ef419fc4-5fe7-4983-83af-af7ef0abd8fd; basis: the find_power_agreements(customer_id) return lists exactly one electricity agreement for Diane (Price Lock 24 at 2207 Brookside Lane), and the tool docstring says the Id is 'the residential electricity agreement number ... as read from the agreement lookup'; uniqueness: she holds no other electricity agreement, so every correct agent passes this id.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.variant_name: value Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24; basis: the initial renewal notice of 2026-09-01 states offered plan 'Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24', and the renewal rule says 'the agreement takes the offered plan'; uniqueness: it is the only renewal notice on the agreement, and accepting any other plan would be a plan change, not a renewal, so every other enum value is excluded.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.plan_change_date: value 2026-11-01; basis: base renewal rule 'When the election is made on or before contract_end_date, the new term starts the day after contract_end_date'; the agreement's contract end date is 2026-10-31 and the election is made on 2026-09-24; uniqueness: forced by the rule.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.contract_end_date: value 2028-10-31; basis: base rule 'The new contract_end_date is counted from the start of the new term in the same way as at activation', i.e. 'the day before the same calendar day term_months calendar months after' the start: 2026-11-01 + 24 months = 2028-11-01, the day before is 2028-10-31; uniqueness: forced by the counting rule.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.contract_rate_cents_kwh: value 10.42. Standard: offered renewal rate on the latest renewal notice = 11.89. Tenure reduction: service start 2024-11-01 is 22 whole months before 2026-09-24 (18 to 35) -> 0.25. Bundle reduction: after the restored line, 11 dual-fuel credit lines with cycle start in the last twelve whole months -> full 0.30 (only 10 before restoration -> partial 0.15). Commitment reduction: expiring term 2024-11-01 through 2026-10-31 = 24 months -> 0.20. Paperless reduction: web enrollment and email notice -> 0.10. Early election reduction: 37 days before 2026-10-31 -> 0.20. Combined 1.05; volume scaling: average 1,006.9 kWh (1,000 or more) -> x1.4 = 1.47. 11.89 - 1.47 = 10.42.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Free pairs: (restoration, referral) and (referral, acceptance). Neither pair shares an input: the referral computation reads the plan referral credit (50.00 on every plan of the charter), the contract end date stated on the latest renewal notice (2026-10-31, which no write of this tree changes), referral and energy line counts, notices and the gas agreement; the acceptance rewrites only agreement term fields (plan, term, rate, plan change date, contract end date) and the restoration adds only a dual-fuel line; the renewal rate and restoration read no referral line. Actual replay with the acceptance before the referral (order 12, 16, 14, 18) gives 12.50, 10.42, 92.50, 116.00 and the same terminal hash as the gold order 12, 14, 16, 18. The remaining orders are pinned by the prerequisite sentences: the renewal rate waits on the dual-fuel credits owed, and the loyalty credit waits on the renewed term and on the referral credits owed.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the restoration leaves 10 dual-fuel lines in the window: the bundle reduction drops to 0.15 and the accepted renewal rate becomes 10.63 instead of 10.42; the terminal state also lacks the 2026-07-01 dual-fuel line.

Without the acceptance the agreement has no renewed term: the renewed-term count cannot be formed (the loyalty compute raises on the empty term start date), and the terminal agreement keeps plan_change_date empty, contract end 2026-10-31 and rate 10.89 instead of 2026-11-01 / 2028-10-31 / 10.42.

Skipping the referral credit leaves no referral line: the referral loyalty bonus falls to 0 and the loyalty credit becomes 106.00 instead of 116.00; the terminal state also lacks the -92.50 referral line.
